headline: Retirement requests for five town employees, plus five consultant invoices, including $20,944.73 from DAHAB Associates.
summary: A police captain, a firefighter, and three other employees have asked to retire, one of them for a service-related disability. Also on the agenda are an October financial performance presentation from DAHAB and an executive session, if the town attorney recommends one.
items: Presentation from DAHAB on October preliminary performance
Invoice from DAHAB Associates for $20,944.73 for July 1 to September 30, 2026, full service
Invoice from Segal for $11,250.00, retainer for Q4 2026
Invoice from Segal for $2,370.00, one Qdro calculation and eleven benefits calculation reviews
Invoice from Segal for $720.00, four benefits calculations
Invoice from Segal for $11,250.00, retainer for Q3 2026
Captain Diaz, Police Captain Anthony Diaz, normal retirement effective November 30, 2026
Gary Greene, firefighter, normal retirement effective November 30, 2026
Sandra Lee Wright, Police Department account clerk, normal retirement effective November 30, 2026
John Richard Croce, Public Works heavy equipment operator, normal retirement effective November 30, 2026
Gary Miller, Public Works heavy equipment operator, service-related disability retirement effective November 30, 2026
Break for executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
location: Hamden Government Center, Third Floor Conference Room, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518, and via Zoom
